action.action-desc: Mr. Moolenaar introduced the following bill; which was referred to the Committee on the Judiciary

form.official-title: To amend section 1839 of title 18, United States Code, to provide that an entity domiciled in a foreign adversary country is a foreign instrumentality for purposes of the prohibition on economic espionage under such section.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Stop PRC Economic Espionage Act of 2026.

section.header: Providing that an entity domiciled in a foreign adversary country is a foreign instrumentality
section.text: Section 1839(1) of title 18, United States Code, is amended by striking is substantially owned, controlled, sponsored, commanded, managed, or dominated by a foreign government; and inserting the following:

subparagraph.text: substantially owned, controlled, sponsored, commanded, managed, or dominated by a foreign government; or
domiciled in a covered nation, as defined in section 4872 of title 10;
